title: Host runtime observability correlation pack
notes: This pack is live and driven by the host runtime agent plus stale telemetry monitor.
All pressure, stale telemetry, and service flapping conditions emit platform host metrics events that are correlated through the standard stream pipeline.
The remaining batch rules are retained as follow-up analytics ideas, but the operational incident path now runs through the stream rules below.

stream_rules.title: Host CPU Pressure Sustained
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Host CPU Pressure Sustained
id: sigma-host-cpu-pressure-sustained
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: infrastructure
  service: host_metrics
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: host.metrics
    event.type: host_cpu_pressure
  condition: selection
level: high
tags:
  - platform.host_health
  - platform.capacity
  - platform.cpu

batch_rules.title: Host Telemetry Missing Daily Review
batch_rules.description: Daily batch review for long-lived telemetry gaps and hosts that never reported during the reporting window.

batch_rules.title: Host Service Flapping Trend Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review for hosts that repeatedly flap over longer windows even when the stream alerts were acknowledged.

batch_rules.title: Storage Node Pressure Trend Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review for capacity trend analysis on storage nodes and ClickHouse replica health.

batch_rules.title: Control Plane Runtime Trend Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review for persistent web/control-plane memory, CPU, and latency patterns beyond the real-time alerting thresholds.
